prompt: A drowned horror lunging straight at the viewer to seize them, seen from just in front at chest height: its sack-bound head thrust forward and tilted, both long grey arms reaching out toward the camera with hooked bony fingers splayed wide, torso twisted, wet rags flying back. The head is bound in a waterlogged burlap sack cinched with rope; the cloth is blank and smooth, a dark wet stain spreading where a mouth would be. Grey-blue drowned skin with black veins, kelp tangled on the arms. Realistic oil-painted figure with smooth tonal shading and no outlines, harsh warm lantern light from below throwing hard upward shadows. Whole figure in frame with margin all round. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
